feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 July 2026 5:49pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 01 July 2026 at 5:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of Ireland tracks eastwards, bringing a frontal zone across the area.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 occasionally 7 this evening, then veering West or Northwest soon after midnight. Decreasing mainly 3 or 4 early tomorrow afternoon, but remaining 5 occasionally 6 in the north and far east of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building mainly moderate this evening, then falling slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle, becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 3 or 4, but 5 occasionally 6 in the north and far east of the area, becoming 2 to 4 in all waters tomorrow evening. Backing South or Southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
